age.source: Patient administration system. Age on the admission date.
age.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

sex.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

deprivation_decile.description: Deprivation of the area the patient lives in (1 = most deprived, 10 = least).
deprivation_decile.source: Derived from the home postcode on the patient administration system.
deprivation_decile.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

long_term_conditions.description: Number of long-term conditions on the patient's record.
long_term_conditions.source: Linked GP record. Conditions coded up to the admission date.
long_term_conditions.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

emergency_admissions_prev_12m.description: Emergency admissions in the year before this one.
emergency_admissions_prev_12m.source: Hospital admissions data. The 12 months before the admission date.
emergency_admissions_prev_12m.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

length_of_stay_days.description: Days in hospital for this admission.
length_of_stay_days.source: Patient administration system. Admission date to discharge date.
length_of_stay_days.why: A stay isn't over until the patient leaves, so you couldn't know this at admission. But the model is run as the patient leaves, and by then we do have it. The moment the model is run decides what counts.

number_of_medications.description: Medicines the patient is discharged on.
number_of_medications.why: The discharge prescription is written before the patient leaves, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_destination.description: Home, home with a care package, or care home.
discharge_destination.source: Patient administration system. The discharge record.
discharge_destination.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

lives_alone.source: Social history taken during the admission.
lives_alone.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_specialty.description: The specialty the patient was discharged from.
discharge_specialty.source: Patient administration system. The discharge record.
discharge_specialty.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_day.description: Day of the week of discharge.
discharge_day.source: Patient administration system. Day of the week of the discharge date.
discharge_day.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

gp_contacts_since_discharge.description: Number of contacts with the patient's GP practice in the last 30 days.
gp_contacts_since_discharge.source: Linked GP record. Contacts in the 30 days before the extract date.
gp_contacts_since_discharge.why: At discharge you could fill in a 'last 30 days' count, but it would cover the 30 days before the patient left, mostly spent in hospital. In the training data the 30 days were counted back from the extract date, so they cover the month after discharge, when patients who are getting worse see their GP more. Same name, different information.

outpatient_followup_attended.description: Whether the patient attended an outpatient follow-up appointment.
outpatient_followup_attended.source: Outpatient system. Status of the first follow-up appointment, as at the extract date.
outpatient_followup_attended.why: Whether a follow-up was attended can only be recorded once the appointment date has passed, which is after discharge.

community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.description: Number of community nursing visits to the patient in the last 30 days.
community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.source: Community services record. Visits in the 30 days before the extract date.
community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.why: In the training data the 'last 30 days' are the month after discharge, so this counts visits made after the patient went home, which readmitted patients tend to have more of. At discharge the same field would count something else.
